Welcome to The Carrington in Morgan Creek! This spacious 2042 sq.ft. end-unit townhome offers 3 bedrooms + den/flex, 3 bathrooms and a highly desirable primary bedroom on the main. Bright living and dining areas, gas fireplace, functional kitchen and a private fenced patio/yard make this home easy to enjoy. Upstairs features a second bedroom, den/flex space and storage. Double garage plus visitor parking. Resort-style amenities include outdoor pool, hot tub, gym, clubhouse, guest suite and tennis / Pickle Ball courts. Gated 55+ community close to golf, shopping and transit! OPEN HOUSE SUNDAY NOV 13 2-4PM
